id.doc: Unique within one request; resolvable by search.perform until the next query.

score.doc: 0..1, higher is better; the engine already orders the list.

actions.doc: First action marked primary runs on Enter.

preview.doc: Only CHEAP inline previews (calculator, text snippets). Use search.preview for expensive ones (file content, images) for the selected result only.

results.doc: The COMPLETE merged, ordered list so far (replace, don't append).

requestId.doc: Pass to search.perform / search.preview for results of this list; resolvable until the next search.query.

search.results.doc: Streamed: fast providers answer first, files later. Ignore events whose requestId is not the latest.

search.query.doc: Starts a search; results arrive as search.results. Starting a new query cancels the previous one.

search.recent.doc: Shown when the query is empty.

search.preview.doc: Lazy preview for the selected result (text file head, image thumbnail url, ...). kind=none if unavailable.
